BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE practice_learning_route_resolution (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    task_instance_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    task_revision_id uuid NOT NULL,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    route_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (route_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    route_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (
        jsonb_typeof(route_json) = 'object'
        AND route_json->>'schema' = 'student-task-learning-snapshot.v1'
        AND route_json->>'id' = id::text
        AND route_json->>'task_instance_id' = task_instance_id::text
        AND route_json->>'task_revision_id' = task_revision_id::text
        AND route_json->>'student_id' = student_id::text
        AND route_json->>'route_digest' = route_digest
    ),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX practice_learning_route_student_idx
    ON practice_learning_route_resolution(student_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_practice_learning_route_resolution()
RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'practice learning routes are immutable';
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_practice_learning_route_resolution
BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON practice_learning_route_resolution
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_practice_learning_route_resolution();

COMMIT;
